transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
Since my grandson was killed, I just can’t feel warmth or happiness the way I should. My daughter can sit beside me and hold my hand—I know I love her—but inside, I don’t feel it at all.
Do you find yourself having unwanted, distressing memories or nightmares about what happened to your grandson?
Yes. I’ll be folding a quilt square or reaching for my tea, and all of a sudden I hear those shots again. I see him lying outside the community center like it’s happening right in front of me.
How long ago did this happen to your grandson?
It’s been six days now—six days since he was killed outside the community center.
